label: Initiation Rite
notes: Ceremonies marking passage from one life stage or social status to another (e.g., adolescence to adulthood)

label: Purification Rite
notes: Ritual cleansing using elements like water, fire, smoke, or incantations to remove defilement

label: Sacrifice
notes: Offering of life (animal, human) or valuable goods (food, objects) to deities or spirits

label: Enthronement/Coronation
notes: Ceremonies legitimizing and investing a ruler with authority

label: Divination
notes: Practices for seeking knowledge of the future or hidden things through omens, oracles, or supernatural means

label: Funeral Rite
notes: Ceremonies associated with the disposal of the dead and guidance of the soul

label: Marriage Rite
notes: Rituals establishing a socially recognized union between partners

label: Separation Phase (Van Gennep)
notes: First phase of a rite of passage, detaching from former social state

label: Liminal Phase (Van Gennep)
notes: Transitional, 'in-between' phase of a rite of passage; ambiguous state

label: Aggregation Phase (Van Gennep)
notes: Final phase of a rite of passage, re-integration into society in a new state

label: Pilgrimage
notes: Sacred journey to a holy site for spiritual purposes

label: Festival
notes: Communal, often calendrical, celebrations involving feasting, performance, and religious observance

label: Healing Rite
notes: Rituals performed to cure illness, restore well-being, or expel disease-causing spirits

label: Commemorative Rite
notes: Rituals reenacting or memorializing significant mythical or historical events

label: Offering
notes: General act of presenting gifts, libations, or non-sacrificial items to divine beings or spirits

label: Exorcism/Apotropaic Rite
notes: Rituals to expel malevolent entities or avert evil influences and misfortune

label: Foundation Rite
notes: Rituals performed to consecrate a new building, city, or sacred space

label: Oath/Vow
notes: Solemn promise, pledge, or binding declaration, often witnessed by divine powers
